title: Stylish iron; runs hotter than expected; wish it were cordless
text:
Stylish iron; runs hotter than expected; wish it were cordless. I own a cordless Hamilton Beach iron that is over 26 years old. It is simple to operate and I love it. I expected this CHI iron to blow me away compared to my old one and to some extent it does but not totally.

I ironed a cotton shirt (see before and after photos in the last two pictures). What I discovered is that the temperature runs hotter than expected as the shirt material was adhering to the bottom of the iron. Therefore, when I put it on cotton, which is what the shirt is, it was too hot. The iron became "sticky" and it was difficult to move even though I used the spray and steam buttons to dampen the cloth. I even tried certain sections not damp but it was still "sticky." Instead I had to lower the temperature to wool in order to continue pressing the shirt.

Also, during ironing, the cord kept getting in the way even though it swivels. However, this is typical of any iron with an attached cord.

When I was done ironing, I had to get the debris left behind from ironing the cotton shirt off the faceplate. That came off easily by ironing over a damp 100% cotton cloth. I also had to clean the iron using the self-clean button. That did not work so well in the sense that water still remained in the iron after self-cleaning was done even after I rocked the iron back and forth over the sink while pressing the button. Instead I had to turn the iron over to drain out the remaining water.

PROS
- This iron is very stylish; it's almost like functional art (see photos).
- The cord swivels and has a Velcro tie for wrapping it up when done.
- The steam and spray buttons work very well.
- The iron is easy to fill with water.
- It heats up rapidly.
- Fabric selection is easily set.
- It is exceptionally easy to clean the soleplate.

CONS:
- The iron runs hotter than typical for the fabric selected. At least that is what I noticed with the cotton.
- The cord gets in the way of what is being ironed; however, that is typical of any corded iron not just this one.
- The self clean button does not steam out all the water as instructions seem to indicate.

In general, this is a nice iron that is almost a work of art. It heats up rapidly and cools down pretty quickly too. It irons well but the cord gets in the way of ironing. Also, the fabric temperature setting runs hotter than expected and self-clean does not release all the water. Nevertheless, it irons well as long as one lowers the temperature. Cleaning the soleplate is a breeze.

product_metadata.title: CHI Steam 2-in-1 Steam Iron and Vertical Garment Steamer with Targeted SteamShot for Clothes with Titanium Infused Soleplate, 1200 Watts, 10’ Cord (13108)
features: TARGETED STEAM NOZZLE BLASTS HEAVY STEAM EXACTLY WHERE NEEDED. Just push the lever and let go. Steam blasts from the front nozzle on the steam iron so you can use it like a garment steamer. There's no need to hold down a button.
WITH CHI FLAT IRON TECHNOLOGY: Titanium-infused ceramic soleplate on the steam iron heats quickly, is scratch-resistant, and smoothly glides over clothing and other textiles.

STEAM PUMP FOR SUPERIOR PERFORMANCE. The steam pump on this 2-in-1 CHI iron and steamer is designed for performance and pumps powerful blasts of high-velocity steam when you need it, making it the ideal steam iron for clothes.
COMFORT-GRIP HANDLE: The steam iron is comfortable to hold and easy to grasp.
ADJUSTABLE FABRIC SELECTOR GUIDE: Choose the right temperature for ironing using the easy-to-use fabric selector guide.
100% QUALITY TESTED: All CHI irons are pre-tested at the factory to ensure excellent quality when it arrives to your home. Condensation may be visible in the steam chamber from this test.
description: The versatile CHI 2-in-1 Steam Iron and Vertical Garment Steamer with Targeted SteamShot nozzle blasts steam from the soleplate, or slide the lever and you get continuous steam from the targeted nozzle in the front of the iron without having to hold down a button.

details.Care instructions: 1. Unplug. Allow iron to cool. 2. To empty water from iron, lift Water Fill Door and slowly tilt pointed end of iron over a sink until all the water has poured out. 3. Store iron on the Heel Rest. Allow iron to cool before storing.
